claims.evidence: A round badge is visible on the engine side but its text is not legible in the photo; no close-up or readable nameplate shot provided.
No legible model plate, serial tag, or stamped casting number visible in the report.

Context shows a green generator canopy and red electrical control box behind the engine, consistent with a stationary genset setup rather than a marine propulsion mount; no transom, gearbox, or marine cooling manifold is described.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run
risks.proof: Video clip of engine cranking and running, or at minimum a clear audio/visual of ignition attempt

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete internal components (pistons, turbo, injectors)
risks.proof: Photos of valve cover removed, turbo mount, and injector ports showing parts present
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete core, worst case

risks.risk: Unreadable brand/model badge cannot confirm Detroit 671 identity
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the badge/nameplate and any stamped block serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded industrial diesel engine, not as a verified Detroit 671

risks.risk: Structural damage or cracks under heavy rust/oxidation
risks.proof: Close-up photos of block, head, and base from multiple angles in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily corroded, possible structural risk

risks.risk: Disconnected hoses/wires suggest missing or damaged wiring harness and sensors
risks.proof: Photo showing full wiring harness intact and connected, plus gauge panel close-up
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full rewiring/sensor replacement

risks.risk: No usage/maintenance history or hour meter reading
risks.proof: Photo of hour meter or any service log/sticker

proof_requests: Close-up, legible photo of the engine badge/nameplate and any stamped serial/model number
Video of the engine attempting to start and, if possible, running
Photos with valve covers off or access panels open showing pistons/injectors/turbo presence
Multiple close-up shots of the block and base for cracks or structural damage under the rust
Photo of hour meter, service stickers, or any paperwork
Wider shot showing full wiring harness and gauge connections intact
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a stationary/industrial diesel engine, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-brand, non-running, heavily corroded core pending the listed proofs; the marine-engine claim is contradicted by the generator-canopy context.
